For a small commercial building in Indore, I’d prioritize serviceability + pressure consistency, not just HP.

Option	Typical price	Best for	When premium is justified
CRI 1–1.5 HP booster	₹24k–38k	Daily commercial use	Good middle ground; worth it for multiple floors/steady usage. 
Moglix

Kirloskar CPBS 1–1.5 HP	₹28k–35k	Offices/shops	Best overall if downtime matters; strong Indian service ecosystem. 
Kirloskar E-shop

Grundfos ~0.9–1 HP	~₹46k+	Premium installations	Justified for quieter operation, higher reliability and heavy daily usage.

My pick: Kirloskar CPBS. Spend extra over a basic ₹8k–15k pump if the building has 3+ floors, frequent simultaneous taps, or rental/commercial tenants. Otherwise, premium hardware may not pay back.

For a 50-person Indian company, the key difference is that Trip.com is primarily an OTA, while the alternatives provide a more structured corporate-travel programme.

Provider	Current price	Exclusions / watch-outs	Best for
Trip.com	No fixed corporate fee; flight fare + any applicable service fee at checkout	Airline fare rules still govern changes/refunds; corporate approvals, GST workflows and account-level management are less comprehensive than a TMC. 
Trip.com
+1
	Teams mainly wanting cheap/quick flight booking
MakeMyTrip myBiz	Custom service fee agreed in contract + 1.5% payment-gateway fee on certain card/wallet payments	Service fee, GST and gateway charges; special fares have their own conditions. 
MakeMyTrip
	Indian SME, GST invoices, domestic travel and simple employee booking
FCM Travel	Custom quote	Management/transaction fees, implementation and any offline/after-hours charges must be quoted	Companies wanting managed travel, policy, approvals and 24/7 human support. 
FCM Travel
+1

Corporate Traveller	Custom quote	Confirm transaction fees, after-hours support, implementation and credit terms	SME-focused managed travel, particularly if you want more human assistance than an OTA

For a 50-person company, get all four to quote the same 12-month travel volume. Ask for the all-in cost including service fees, GST, cancellations, amendments, offline-agent support and implementation.
